### Participating projects

This cluster brings together projects

- [**P06** - The (Non-)Deficiency and (Non-)Redundancy of Clitic Pronouns](../subprojects/P06.qmd),
- [**P07** - Deficiency and Redundancy in Iberoromance Pronominal Systems](../subprojects/P07.qmd),
- [**P08** - Fading Reference - The Pragmaticalization of Pronoun + Verb](../subprojects/P08.qmd),
- [**P09** - Animacy Features and the Flexibility of Pronouns](../subprojects/P09.qmd).

### Description

The Romance Data cluster focuses on collaborative empirical work across Romance languages and varieties. A central activity has been a data-sharing initiative designed to facilitate access to relevant empirical materials across subprojects, alongside coordinated experimental work. One concrete outcome of this collaboration is a cross-Romance experiment on null objects across eight Romance varieties, involving subprojects P01, P06, P07, and P09 and extending cooperation beyond the immediate cluster.
